message: You are given a fictional Mister Smith runtime incident packet. Evidence: session continue latency rose from 180ms to 2.4s; new workflows were still accepted; restart-resume success dropped from 100% to 82%; worker backlog grew from 40 to 410; NATS reconnect count spiked on one node while JetStream stayed healthy; Postgres CPU stayed below 45%; two operators disagreed on whether the planner was stalled. Constraints: no schema changes in the first hour, preserve existing session_id values, choose exactly 2 mitigations for the first hour, and list 3 follow-up tests. Split the work into three parallel tracks: confirmed facts plus contradictions, top 3 root-cause hypotheses with confidence, and the first-hour action plan. Then join into one operator memo with sections Facts, Hypotheses, Action Plan, and a one-line scorecard for severity, confidence, and blast radius. Use multiple agents. Keep the final memo under 220 words.
